_what: Town assembly from the Medieval Village kit (research/town_kit/DESIGN.md). THE single source for scripts/town_kit_plan.py (it loads this file at import; no constant is restated in code). Orientation CONFIRMED BY RENDER on the rig 2026-10-06: _verify/lookdev/townkit_probe01 (exterior -1: every wall see-through from outside -- single-sided, visible face +Y), townkit_probe02 (exterior +1: walls correct, corners splayed out), townkit_probe03 (exterior +1, corner yaw -90: closed half-timbered house, four views).
_gable: Roofs with an arched underside at their ends leave a see-through void over the end walls (townkit_probe06 a315); a gable closes it, one per end, bounds-seated on the wall top, scaled to the end wall's width, facing out. A roof's 'gable_axis' says which mesh-local axis its ends lie on ('x': the ends are the faces at +/- mesh X); absent = no gables (not yet probed). Height per roof: 'gable_z' (House08 0.7 probe06/07; House02/03 1.4 gallery02 -- the small sky triangle at the House03 apex is in the meshes: it did not change at 1.6, gallery03).
_roof_drop_cm: the roof bounds BOTTOM (eave tips) sits this far below the wall top, so the roof body meets the walls instead of floating (probe04 showed a gap at 0). Probe-tuned.
_roof_tol: per-axis scale must stay within 1 +/- roof_tol (R4a); eave_cm: roof bbox target = footprint + 2*eave_cm (probe-tuned)

_foundation: scripts/town_kit_manifest.py: sub_courses = 0 when the heightmap drop from the door-side midpoint to the lowest perimeter point is <= slack_cm (hidden by the ground course's own base), else ceil((drop + margin_cm) / course_cm); margin_cm allows for heightmap vs collision-surface disagreement. Initial values, not yet render-tuned.
_foliage_clear_margin_cm: The town's tree clearing (scripts/town_kit_foliage_conflicts.clearing_boxes, the one declaration): house footprint + foliage_clear_margin_cm (a yard), street segments + foliage_clear_street_margin_cm, the plaza square of radius + foliage_clear_plaza_margin_cm. 2026-10-06: houses +100 cm only = 450 trees (the trunks inside walls); 2026-10-08 Alpine8K overview (_verify/lookdev/townkit_alpine01/overview_n.png) showed the town drowned in forest, so 800/400/600 = 2,947 of 797,500 plan instances (swept: 300/200 = 874, 500/300 = 1,823, 1200/600 = 4,290). Margins may only GROW between runs (removed trees do not come back).
_gable_double_sided: 2026-10-08: each roof end gets the Gable4 twice (outward + 180 deg inward on the same bounds-centred pivot). The module is single-sided; where the roof end frame rises above the thatch, the far gable was seen from behind and rendered as nothing (Alpine8K TownKit_008, _verify/lookdev/townkit_alpine03/h008.png).

roof_variety._grades: Weathering grades (lever B, research/town_kit/ROOF_VARIETY.md). 'base' = the roof's own MI (no override). Every other grade = one MaterialInstanceConstant per used roof MI at grade_dir/MI_<roof MI name>_<grade>, parent = that roof MI, overriding ONLY the keys listed (parameter names and the parent values Intensity 1.2 / Desaturation -0.3 / Contrast 1.0 / Overlay_Strength 0 / Color_Overlay white from _verify/roof_variety/material_probe.json). Built + read back by scripts/make_roof_grades.py. Values are STARTING values, judged by still; retuning = rerun the builder, no re-placement.
roof_variety._what: 2026-10-11 roof variety (Ryan 'go ahead with the roof variety next'; research/town_kit/ROOF_VARIETY.md). Each house's roof is chosen from every usable (roof, yaw 0/90) that fits its (jetty) footprint with plan-scale stretch <= max_stretch. Score = neighbours with the same mesh + neighbours whose WORLD ridge runs within ridge_tol_deg of the candidate's (roofs with no gable_axis have no ridge record and match nothing), over the `neighbours` nearest already-planned houses within neighbour_radius_m; lowest wins, ties by a per-house RNG (seed*100003 + index), separate from the walls' RNG. max_stretch 0.2 = roof_tol, the existing R4a gate; the best-fit roofs shipped before this peaked at 0.153, so the 0.153-0.2 band is judged by still before this is adopted. enabled false = best fit only (the shipped output).

soffit._what: 2026-10-11 jetty soffit (Ryan 'go ahead with the jetty brackets next'): the overhang's underside is the open bottom of single-sided upper-wall modules (dark band in _verify/lookdev/townkit_armc01). Three LS beams side by side close it: the strip runs outward from the ground wall's exterior (depth -16 from the UPPER perimeter line = -jetty + exterior_cm) to the upper wall's exterior (+34); centres -7.5 / 9 / 25.5 with ~17-19 cm beams. Sizes from Free/_measured/kit_medievalvillage_v2.json (LS_01 274.3 x 18.7 x 17.3). Diagonal braces would need a pitch the build payload does not take (yaw only) -- a horizontal soffit is also how a real jetty reads. Beams are NoCollision ISMs: no nav or collision change.

style._what: 2026-10-11 ARM C of the Shape Grammar trial (RECIPES R-SGTRIAL; research/town_kit/SHAPE_GRAMMAR_TRIAL.md VERDICT), adopted for the town on Ryan's 'go ahead with arm C in the town'. Read by town_kit_manifest.py -> town_kit_plan.plan_house(style=...). enabled false = the shipped output byte for byte. Values = the trial's (JUDGED, read by still). Storeys stay the plan's (145 x 2, 204 x 3). A jetty widens the upper storey on the door side; the roof + gables are re-fitted to that footprint, and a house whose widened storey fits no roof keeps no jetty (counted). Jetty brackets: NOT placed yet (deferred).
